profile.description: OQ Exploration and Production SAOG engages in the exploration, prospecting, development, and extraction of crude oil and natural gas in the Sultanate of Oman. It identifies, acquires, operates, and manages interests in oil and gas properties. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Muscat, the Sultanate of Oman. OQ Exploration and Production SAOG operates as a subsidiary of OQ SAOC.
